what_this_is: The five definitions any x402 measurement should state (see agreement_2026-11.md), for this census. test_measurement_card.py fails if this file and the census disagree.

population.source: CDP Bazaar discovery listings, deduplicated to one probe URL per host
population.note: The list is pinned. Hosts that joined the catalog after it was collected are not added.

probe.method: preflight.classify_both(url) — one to three unauthenticated requests per host: a GET, then a POST when the GET did not produce a challenge, plus one immediate retry when the only thing the first attempt observed was a transport failure. Nothing signed, nothing paid. A verdict describes what the endpoint served at that moment and nothing about the operator.
probe.retry_rule: one immediate retry, UNREACHABLE first attempts only, never policy refusals, never answers; retried rows carry retried=true

broken.term_used: none. The census does not label hosts broken; it gives each host one verdict per day.

verdicts.BLOCKED: a stock v2 client CANNOT construct a payment
verdicts.OK: a stock v2 client can sign this
verdicts.RATE_LIMITED: not assessed - the probe was rate-limited
verdicts.V1: v1 challenge - a v2 client cannot read it at all

payment_terms_read_from.v2_verdict: the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header when it parses, otherwise the body
payment_terms_read_from.v1_verdict: the body only, as a v1 client reads it
